Name: Elam, of the Return
Summary: Head of a family that returned with Zerubbabel; Jeshaiah of his sons returned with Ezra. A different Elam from Shem's son, and from the other Elam of Ezra 2:31.
LifeLesson: Faithfulness in returning to rebuild is remembered by name.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile
